notes: Manufacturer is ART (Applied Research and Technology). The current shipping product is the "Tube MP Studio V3" (V3 = Variable Valve Voicing preset feature); ART's site no longer lists a plain non-V3 "Tube MP Studio," so this V3 spec is used to answer "ART Tube MP Studio." Data cross-verified from the manufacturer product page (https://artproaudio.com/microphone-preamps/product/811311/tubempstudiov3) and the official Owner's Manual PDF (linked above), both current as of 2026. All four audio I/O jacks are on the rear panel per the manual's "CONNECTIONS" section ("All inputs and outputs are located on the rear panel"), even though front-panel product photography shows the two 1/4" jacks along the top edge of the control face — front and rear are effectively the same panel in this compact enclosure. No physical port carries a bandwidth "grade" (all are analog audio or DC power), so grade is omitted throughout. Power is delivered via an external "universal" wall-wart adapter (100-240V AC, 4 swappable regional mains clips) feeding a DC jack on the unit labeled "Pwr"; connector style is a coaxial DC barrel jack (closest match in the allowed list to the actual small-barrel plug ART ships, exact barrel size not published). Desktop unit, not rack-mountable (2" x 5.5" x 5", 1.5 lbs) — rackUnits omitted. No enumerated "type" value cleanly fits a tube mic preamp/DI (not an "Audio Interface," "Amplifier," or "Audio mixer" in the conventional sense), so type is omitted; category "audio" is used instead.

ports.name: 1/4" Input
ports.note: Unbalanced instrument/line-level input, high impedance (840K ohms), max +22dBu

ports.name: XLR Input
ports.note: Balanced mic input, switchable +48V phantom power, max +14dBu, input impedance 3K ohms

ports.name: XLR Output
ports.note: Active balanced output, usable unbalanced, max +28dBu, 600 ohm output impedance

ports.name: 1/4" Output
ports.note: Unbalanced output, max +22dBu, 300 ohm output impedance

ports.name: Pwr
ports.note: DC input for included universal external power adapter (100-240V AC ~50/60Hz in, 12V DC @ >=800mA out)
